name: vintage-bathroom-red-polka-dot-beauty
image_vibe: Nostalgic vintage bathroom, warm creams and vibrant reds, relaxed analog editorial
image_purpose: Create a refined retro bathroom fashion portrait with natural texture and nostalgic color.

prompt.project_info: A photorealistic 35mm editorial portrait in a vintage bathroom.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with long loose slightly messy hair draped over one shoulder and a soft neutral expression. She wears a red polka-dot romper with white ruffled trim and short puffy sleeves, paired with red strappy stilettos and thin rings.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level medium shot, kneeling on the tiled floor and leaning slightly back, one hand on her thigh and the other touching her heel. Include small white square floor tiles, cream cabinet, mirrored door with taped photos, scattered shoes, and a magazine.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused natural indoor window light, warm creams, vibrant reds, soft whites, relaxed nostalgic mood, and realistic shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm lens, f/4.0, photorealistic RAW aesthetic, natural skin and fabric texture, restrained detail, soft realistic reflections, no artificial overprocessing.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic 35mm f/4.0 eye-level medium portrait of an original adult woman in a vintage bathroom. Give her long loose slightly messy hair draped over one shoulder and a soft neutral expression. She wears a red polka-dot romper with white ruffled trim and short puffy sleeves, red strappy stilettos, and thin rings. Pose her kneeling on the small white square tiled floor, leaning slightly back, with one hand on her thigh and the other touching her heel. Include a cream cabinet, mirrored door with taped photos, scattered shoes, and a magazine. Use soft diffused natural indoor light, warm cream, vibrant red and soft white colors, realistic RAW texture, and relaxed nostalgic editorial mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, transparent romper, exposed underwear, nudity, fetish framing, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source vintage bathroom reference
assets.usage: Use only for bathroom setting, red polka-dot wardrobe, pose, props, and color treatment; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the red polka-dot romper, bathroom props, kneeling editorial pose, 35mm lens, and nostalgic palette. Keep the subject original adult and outfit opaque; props may vary.

changes: Removed public-figure resemblance and specified an original adult subject.
Added opaque wardrobe and safety exclusions while preserving the retro fashion concept.
